e long hours, ‘on feet all day’ | added this for you even though | am

However, the expression ‘on her feet all day’ actually means that

This sample question is actually good practice on a different type of
situation which you may get in your exam. If you ever get something like
this in your exam, keep these things in mind:

¢ Who am| writing to?

@ What do! want her to do?

* What does she need to know to do her job?

Good work on this one.

| Grade: B (360)

| This is a pass but since you need 400, you have to be careful with the little
details. You do not have to change all the words given in the case notes

| (e.g. you can maintain ‘grip strength’) as long as you can construct good

sentences with them. Sometimes using the words in the case notes will
make more sense and can help you write faster as well (and leave you
with some time for proofreading).
